component.name: Organiza
component.summary: Offline-first productivity, focus tracking, and discipline architecture

description.p: Organiza is an offline-first productivity platform combining task management, daily timetable scheduling, deep-work reflection journaling, and unprivileged active-window screen time analytics.

ul.li: Local SQLite database with pre-migration snapshot backups and zero cloud lock-in.
Unprivileged desktop usage tracking via X11 and GNOME Wayland D-Bus.
Distraction blocker with Stoic friction essays and custom curfews.
Battlepass gamification and cohort duels with verifiable wager settlements.

description.p: Initial stable production release with multi-platform local core, offline drift SQLite, and Supabase cloud sync.
